quest.title: The Artist By the Moon's Side (IV)
quest.description: Columbina is having a spot of trouble in the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: ...Here. This is for you. That's my share done, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it's a drawing canvas. Wait, that means...!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Ah. You're just in time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, if it isn't Maalaus, our Great Painter! Long time no see!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what are we "just in time" for?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I just took Maalaus to the moon for a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's sooo jealous of how you just... said that, like you were visiting the garden next door or something.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, what did you go there for? Looking for inspiration?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: That's half right. We also selected a location for an "exhibition." Do you recall?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon does! Maalaus's Moon Goddess exhibition! Don't forget to invite us when the time comes, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes, of course. In addition, Maalaus seems to be able to sense subtle changes around her.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: She's told me that I have changed a lot since returning from the moon.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: That's why she wanted me to take her there, to see if there was something special about it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh! Now that's an artist for you, alright...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, this special thing...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I'm not sure either. I took Maalaus to many places, but none of them satisfied her.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: That is, until I brought her close to your ship.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: But after bringing her closer, I found that she wasn't interested in the ship itself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What does that mean?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh, she's flying around you, Columbina.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Haha. She did so back then as well.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: I suspect that her real interest lies with how I looked after seeing the spaceship.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How you... looked?

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: #Yes. I was reminded of when {NICKNAME} and I went there together.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: #We sat atop the ship, gazing at Teyvat. {M#He}{F#She} found the truth about the past, and I found my "home."

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Just thinking about it gave me a sense of peace... or perhaps, happiness.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Yes, you are right. These are not things I would have felt before.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: So, I told Maalaus our story, including what happened after we reached the moon.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: She seemed most pleased after that, as if she had found the inspiration she so desired.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah. So now it's time for the great artist to work her magic, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, you didn't take Paimon up there back then, so she's pretty curious what Maalaus is gonna paint too!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And what are we going to use as paint this time?

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: This time is something special.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Maalaus says she wants paints that belong only to us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And... what does that mean?

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: I believe she means things that will remind you about this journey, what you have gained from it, and the joy it has brought you.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Don't worry. Maalaus just wants to see such objects and feel them. She wouldn't use anything so precious as paint.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What did you give her?

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Soil from the moon, and the card you gave me for Moon-Prayer Night.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh, so basically, it's gotta be something that represents this adventure, right? Okay then. {NICKNAME}, you pick!

talks.objective: Give the kuuhenki the objects that represent this part of the journey

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hmm. A good choice.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She seems pretty pleased too— Whoa, straight to the canvas she goes!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, now that Paimon thinks about it, Maalaus's paintings pretty much cover your story from when you were born 'til now, Columbina.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And that story isn't over yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! And Paimon wants to see more of our great painter's work, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, done already? Quick as ever, huh.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon see... Oohh! This is so pretty!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon had no idea Teyvat looked so beautiful from the moon...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hah... Now I can understand why Maalaus says that I have changed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? Why's that?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: When I see this painting, I remember...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: That as I sat on the moon, watching Teyvat, I thought about how I'd always been looking for a "home" of my own.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: But now, I suddenly have two homes, both of them places of such beauty.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: It was then that I realized that perhaps "home" is wherever the things and people you cherish are.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A lovely thought.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Thank you. I think that after this, I'd like to take the kuuhenki to the moon more often.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: You're welcome to come visit my "other home" as well.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Oh? You'd like to be a guide for other kuuhenki? Of course. I think this will be a most lively journey.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Colors that represent this part of our journey...)
